title: English Practice Quiz 0856
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Quality Improvement: What does a quality standard define?
options: The required level or criteria for acceptable work

questions.question: Quality Improvement: What is a non-conformity?
options: A failure to meet a specified requirement
questions.explanation: Non-conformity means a requirement has not been met.

questions.question: Quality Improvement: What should a corrective action address?
options: The cause of an identified problem

questions.question: Quality Improvement: How does a quality checklist help?
options: Ensure required steps are consistently checked

questions.question: Quality Improvement: What is a performance indicator used for?
options: Measure progress or results against a target

questions.question: Quality Improvement: What does continuous improvement mean?
questions.explanation: Continuous improvement is an ongoing effort.

questions.question: Quality Improvement: What does a sample audit examine?
options: A selected portion of records or work
questions.explanation: Sampling reviews a subset to assess quality.

questions.question: Quality Improvement: Which evidence best supports a quality finding?
options: A dated inspection record with observed facts
questions.explanation: Dated factual evidence supports reliable findings.

questions.question: Quality Improvement: What does a process map show?
options: The sequence of steps in a process
questions.explanation: A process map visualises how work moves through steps.

questions.question: Quality Improvement: What should follow an improvement?
options: Measure whether the change achieved the intended result
questions.explanation: Measurement confirms whether the improvement was effective.
